name: Cosmosphere
unique: A world class space museum in a Kansas wheat town, with the actual Apollo 13 command module, a V-2 rocket and a Russian space program collection.
buzz: People are stunned by the collection; the planetarium and Dr. Goddard's lab are good for kids. Worth the drive.

name: Flint Hills Tallgrass Prairie
unique: The last large expanse of tallgrass prairie in North America, with bison, prairie chickens and a horizon that does not stop.
buzz: People call it the most underrated landscape in the Midwest; spring wildflowers are extraordinary. Watch for ticks.

name: Monument Rocks
unique: Chalk pyramids and arches left by an ancient sea, rising out of the shortgrass prairie in the middle of nowhere.
buzz: It is a genuine surprise and completely free; the dirt road is rough after rain. Best at sunset.

name: Boot Hill Museum
unique: A recreated 1870s cowtown at the edge of the actual Boot Hill cemetery, with a saloon, a jail, a newspaper office and nightly gunfight reenactments.
buzz: The gunfight show is corny and fun; the museum is better than the show. Combine with the Santa Fe Trail sites.

name: World's Largest Ball of Twine
unique: A continuously growing ball of sisal twine that weighs nearly nine tons, with a gazebo, a guest book and an annual twine festival where anyone can add a strand.
buzz: It is exactly what you hope for: free, absurd and proudly local. Ten minutes and a photo, then back on the highway.
